authority.source: exact TRII/1 installation authority and TRIC/1 plus TRIM/1 IPC authority, committed append-only installation catalog, per-session journals, and exact TRAR/1 recovery journal
authority.serialization: batch-027 requirement-owned fixed formats plus remaining plan-owned record-registry.v1.json over wire-format.v1.json
authority.decision_rule: serialize pre-state, select the section 5.5 race winner, reserve all affected counters, append and durably commit the transition record, then publish post-state
authority.uncommitted_rule: memory state, partial tail, side file, directory existence, and OS object existence cannot upgrade persistent state
authority.credential_prohibition: credential plaintext, candidate bytes, key material, and irreversible comparison material have no persistent field

pre_ready_authority.root_rule: evidence, alarm, and installation runtime roots are pairwise distinct/non-nested user-selected existing absolute paths whose normally resolved final handles prove writable local fixed-disk NTFS, canonical final path, volume serial, file ID, and required access; runtime root is the sole installation/IPC authority parent; reparse components are allowed but unexpected reparse objects in the product-created tree are structural conflicts
pre_ready_authority.installation_record: exact 4096-byte TRII/1 in one of two deterministic create-new attempts

ipc_attempt_resolution.create_action_rule: execute at most one table-selected CREATE_A0 or CREATE_A1 create-new action at a time; a consumed path is never retried, overwritten, truncated, repaired, or resumed
ipc_attempt_resolution.a1_prohibition: no a0 state other than TRIC_INCOMPLETE or TRIC_UNWITNESSED with a1 ABSENT and table action CREATE_A1 can create attempt one
ipc_attempt_resolution.selection_rule: SELECT_A0 or SELECT_A1 identifies the sole complete valid pair; a newly committed CREATE_A0 or CREATE_A1 selects that same attempt file for the current startup

pre_ready_authority.ipc_record_chain: exact sequence-zero TRIC/1 then exact sequence-one TRIM/1 in the single selected attempt file; this selected-file singularity does not reduce the two deterministic reserved paths or forbid the two exact CREATE_A1 recovery cells
pre_ready_authority.ipc_manifest_append_rule: after holder proof execute exactly one TRIM/1 append attempt against the selected committed TRIC/1 file and never against the unselected path
pre_ready_authority.execution_owner: TRANSIENT_STARTUP_COORDINATOR is the sole state and OS-call owner for every TRII/1, TRIC/1, and TRIM/1 path resolution, create-new, explicit-offset exact-single write, flush, witness positive-progress fill, readback, reopen, and final-handle identity operation
pre_ready_authority.execution_primitives: direct frozen bounded terminal-overlapped startup authority I/O; OVERLAPPED, event, buffer, and file handle remain owned until terminal completion; no ordinary worker, mailbox, helper process, or hidden queue
pre_ready_authority.ordinary_worker_dependency: forbidden before matching committed TRIM/1; MONITOR_STORAGE performs only post-TRIM authority adoption and later monitor-journal operations
startup_order: derive current user SID and logon-session ID; acquire session-local initializer authority
derive, guard, and classify exact IPC a0/a1 paths; apply the complete 81-pair action table
execute at most one table-selected create-new action and commit new TRIC/1 in the selected file before any Job/child/mapping/event
create startup Job then service and monitor suspended at creation
complete TRBH/1 identity, final-handle, and close phases
perform the one exact holder proof
drive exactly one TRIM/1 append attempt in the selected file to terminal result
only after committed TRIM/1 start/prove ordinary workers, issue monitor lease, evaluate current liveness, and publish readiness
pre_ready_authority.holder_proof_rule: pre-proof child loss emits no TRIM/1 byte; post-proof child loss latches startup failure but cannot cancel, truncate, or suppress the sole TRIM/1 attempt; successful TRIM/1 remains recovery authority and never asserts commit-time liveness
pre_ready_authority.failure_rule: unavailable, conflict, exhausted, blocked authority, missing witness, incomplete recovery, child loss, or any identity/access-mask mismatch publishes no readiness and authorizes no replacement IPC allocation

metadata_bytes.scope: all committed catalog segment bytes, tombstones, prologues, and one bounded partial tail

limits_and_reservations.reservation_atomicity: A counter and its capacity facts are serialized under the state lock and committed in the same authoritative transition record before the post-state becomes visible. Failure to commit retains the pre-state and no resource may be consumed by forwarding.

transition_validation.race_rule: race_winner is NONE or exactly one value from race_priority; all simultaneous event pairs are resolved by the lowest numeric priority before any transition commit
transition_validation.reason_rule: reason_id is a stable catalog reason, MATCHING_SESSION_TERMINAL_REASON only for REGISTRATION_TERMINALIZED with an exact field-18 equality precondition, or NONE_NONPUBLIC for a non-public nonterminal fact; terminal transitions may not use NONE_NONPUBLIC
transition_validation.selector_rule: a non-null selector_operation is an exact reason-exit-catalog operation and supplies exactly authorization_result, request_validation, serialized_pre_state, race_winner, deadline_fact, limit_kind, fault_kind, operation_discriminator, committed_post_state
transition_validation.record_rule: every writer transition names exactly one committed record kind. Multi-entity atomic projections share one named commit group/record rather than competing commits.
transition_validation.counter_rule: counter_changes explicitly names every increment, decrement, reservation, release, and byte/record charge; empty means no persistent counter changes
transition_validation.recovery_rule: replay applies a transition at most once by record sequence/digest; no directory, side file, memory state, clock, or OS object upgrades state

recovery_order: validate three root handles and resolve exact TRII/1 through unavailable/conflict guards plus the complete six-state 36-pair table before any IPC parent or allocation

derive exact a0/a1 paths, apply unavailable/conflict guards, classify both through the nine states, execute the complete 81-pair table with exactly two CREATE_A1 cells and at most one create-new action at a time, then resolve the single selected TRIC/1-to-TRIM/1 chain

when old ready IPC may remain, acquire the irreversible quiesce/freeze barrier and commit exact TRAR/1 inventory-open, 2052 slot inventories, inventory seal, release proof, required uniquely ordered UNPROVEN resolutions, and recovery-complete

for every old mapping claim the deterministic nonzero freeze generation, request freeze, wait for zero count and stable even sequence, normalize only crash-left count/odd sequence after every mutator is EXITED or IDENTITY_ABSENT, record the stable slot snapshot, then freeze irreversibly; alive QUIESCED never permits normalization
create no replacement mapping, event, worker, or duplicate handle until the old TRAR/1 recovery is complete; on failure retain RECOVERY_BLOCKED_OLD_IPC
validate immutable installation identity, runtime-context attribution, profile, catalog, schema, package, canonical final root paths and volume/file identities
enumerate catalog segments in service-incarnation and segment-index order under all profile tree limits
validate prologue, committed prefix, chain link, record schema, counters, and at most one bounded partial tail per file
rebuild application, registration, credential lifecycle, session, deletion, quota, and tombstone projections by committed sequence
classify every pre-restart nonterminal session read-only as incomplete or terminal-unknown; never append its journal
discard all credential keys and comparison digests; every old ISSUED credential becomes unusable
commit RECOVERY_ACTIVE_RESERVATION_RELEASED in the new catalog segment for every old logical ACTIVE reservation after old session handles and worker resources are proven released
reestablish a fresh monitor lease and all readiness prerequisites before new registration or activation

segment_and_orphan_rule.creation: one lazy catalog segment per service incarnation unless a clean size rollover is required
segment_and_orphan_rule.zero_byte_create_crash: one zero-byte create-new file is a poison sentinel for that exact expected segment; no second file or new mutation is permitted until operator intervention, so the orphan bound is one
segment_and_orphan_rule.partial_tail: retained and charged to metadata bytes; never truncated, repaired, appended, or reused
segment_and_orphan_rule.rollover: only a clean committed seal permits one successor whose prologue binds the predecessor final digest
segment_and_orphan_rule.historical_tombstones: never removed automatically and remain charged to metadata bytes

selector_binding: Every public operation supplies exactly the nine closed facts required by reason-exit-catalog.v1.json. The committed pre-state is serialized before race selection; the selected record's committed post-state is the only post-state fact. Missing, mixed-pattern, contradictory, or uncommitted facts route to that operation's final non-positive otherwise rule.
version_evolution: State codes, transition identities, ordering, counter scopes, and persistent field meanings are immutable for 1.0. Any change requires a reviewed plan amendment, new model vectors, and compatibility decision.
